Read the FloraTend development privacy notice and planned local-first defaults.

In development. App availability, supported devices, translations and Premium purchasing await release verification.

Development privacy notice

This notice describes the current development policy and is not a final release privacy policy. The publisher's legal identity, contact details and applicable rights process must be completed before launch.

Local records by default

The app is designed to store plant records, notes, settings and selected photographs locally. Core plant care does not require an account. No third-party advertising SDKs are planned for version one.

Optional capabilities

Speech recognition and TextToSpeech depend on installed device engines, whose processing may involve their providers. Photo identification and cloud services must remain unavailable until configured, disclosed and consented to as appropriate.

Export and deletion

Release privacy review must verify export destinations, deletion behaviour, backup scope and actual network traffic. A local export leaves app storage at the destination the user chooses.

This website

These static pages include no analytics scripts, tracking pixels, forms or third-party media embeds. A deployed hosting provider may process ordinary request data; its details must be added before publication.
